notes.title: Autumn Update 2-15
notes.content:
Hey you,

slowly the leaves turn their color and begin to fall and dance in the wind. The perfect season to play some strategy games with a cup of hot anything! For this reason we ease your journey by introduce some new features and a lot of fixes we collect the last months.

changes:

 Now you can move the camera in the evaluation screen after the reconnection to see the map more closely (thanks to T.Schaui for this suggestion <3)

 Zoom in - right trigger

 Updated game over screen

 Fixed the FTL (faster than light) mode, which was not working at all (last evolvement level of time)

 . . and a lot of minor graphical and functional changes



Have fun and stay tuned =)

notes.title: Big Community Feedback Update 2-14
notes.content:
Good News Everyone!

We spent the last month collecting your feedback and building the major update 2-14 to spice up your journey in RECONNECT. Meanwhile, people around us celebrating football, ice-cream and cold water to enjoy the summer, but not for us.. With our boiling heads and CPUs, we heated up the evolving summer even more, play tested hundreds of hours abstruse game-configurations, generated a faster/harder starting-gameplay and rethink the overall gameloop. A bunch of lifestreams, articles and early access-players over the past weeks inspired our work to adjust the right things in RECONNECT for an even smoother user-experience.


So, what has happend in details:

New Features
RECONNECT creates individual time lines for each player. With every played round, the result (quit / reconnect / win / game over) will affect all future rounds/gameplay. Some players wanted more feedback in the game, to know where they actually are on their journey. Others wanted an overall speedup. Therefore we introduce these new features:


overall gameloop


AI-Scouts - Until you collected 10% of AI-data, scouts will spice up your building phase. Seeking and extracting data is their main goal, while you strengthen up the defence of your fragile source. Every spawning cycle of the AI, scouts exploring the map to find a source of energy/light. While you stay close in contact with the actual best AI-drones you can observe the development of their behaviour and optimize your network building decisions more quickly. Every new round the amount of scouts differs and evolves with saved AI networks to ensure the right amount of pressure you need to strengthen up your base and prepare for the "big wave".

Reconnection-Screen - See the individual name, fitness and reached generation of your extracted artificial neural network alias LightKnight and the ingame play time. Enjoy the music of the source by watching the waves of the swarm from above. Every reconnection you finished you earn one LightKnight, which spawns spores in the next round to take over replicators.

Game Over-Screen - You know when it is over. The game now slows down, deactivates your builder-tools and give you the name of the first replicator, which destroyed your light-source and therefore was saved. Keep in mind, next round the AI uses this knowledge to grow faster.

Final Decision - This is the realm you started in and in which you will return, when you really "beat" the AI. [spoiler]You will then be confronted with a decision, where you can continue with all of your collected LightKnights and saved Replicators or finally delete all AI data and win the game. Winning the game means, that you have access to the ingame (cheat)terminal, to mutate the world after your needs..[/spoiler]
There is an ongoing discussions about new geometric maps and skins you can achieve. Maybe next update? ;)

Save Recovery - We appreciate the hours you played RECONNECT! That's why we update your save data when you start the game for the first time after this update. All reconnections, LightKnights, Replicators or Coins will be transferred and should be working fine. If not, find us on our discord server for help -> discord
On the other hand, you can delete your save-data and reset RECONNECT, when you delete this folder: C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RobotHeart Lab\\Reconnect



other changes:


 Coin-text-system rework - specialized for spores, new endings and scouts
 screenshot key now F11 (not F12 - steam button conflict) - help screens updated
 blue towers: selector and layers updated
 main menu sound filter rework
 main menu newest LightKnight highlighted
 LightKnight count saved in every round - ReSt.ipc
 replicator balance bar show time optimized
 collectable upgrades rearranged
 various script speed up
 a lot of minor and major bugfixes



Thank You for playing RECONNECT! <3

notes.title: !!! 2-13f3 - critical benchmark bugfix !!!
notes.content:
A big sorry for all players who bought RECONNECT after the last update 2-13f2.

The HUD-Update caused an error on the Benchmark-scene activation, setting the global quality-settings to the absolut minimum. And that is totally not playable at all...

But this is now fixed! 

The only thing you have to do is:

[olist]
Please go to your RECONNECT-save-data-folder 
C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RobotHeart Lab\\Reconnect
(if you cannot see the "AppData"-folder, activate Windows-option "show hidden files/folders")

In that folder delete the "QualitySettings.rqs"-file to reactivate the Benchmark

Start RECONNECT 

Let the Benchmark process finish to generate the best quality settings for your actual hardware
(after it has finished, a new "QualitySettings.rqs"-file is generated)
[/olist]


Please, contact us at the "Official RECONNECT Early Access Hub" server on discord, if you experience any bugs. -> https://discord.gg/Aq8DVnAQc3

notes.title: Release Update 2-13f2 - HUD upgrade and bugfixes

notes.title: --- RECONNECT 2-13 ---
notes.content:
Good neeews everyone,

we proudly present you RECONNECT version 2-13:

Over the weekend we had some discussions about our white LightKnights (your own AI-units after you reconnected for the first time and take the right choices ;) ).

The Fight 4 - Existence was our first prototype of RECONNECT with a hommage to "zombie-ants" (google it, if you hear this the first time! ^^). In short, a ant-eating fungi which infects their brains and acts like a mind-controlling invader defeating whole colonies to eat even more ants. We found it profoundly amazing to see this weirdly epic behaviour and tried to build a game around it. 

Now, five years and a tremendous amount of projects later, our prototype evolved to RECONNECT - The Heart of Darkness and we decided to add some more juice to the gameplay, by inviting the fungi like elements back to the game. 

LightKnights, alias captured AI neural networks, are producing spores, now. Through their disconnection from the AI core, they now loose energy over their lifetime until they finally die. But after that, every corp emits spores, which can infect other AI-units and turn their targets to your favor. Like, you are the fungi and control the AI-units like zombie-ants. 

So in the late game you experience (if you want to..) more tactical play with your own units and the AI itself, rather than focusing on base-building. But the story is not ending here and more strategic updates will come based on your ideas and creativity. So keep playing and evolving! <3

Here is the rest of the lately changes:

 extra upgrades available on playing multiple rounds (AI-development in %) 
 extra upgrades following the fibonacci sequence (1%, 2%, 3%, 5%, 8%, 13%..)
 removed doppler effects on different static soundsources like towers
 removed big chaotic connection bug, when rotating the camera in the building process
 introduce infected AI-units, spore areas, map-symbols and LightKnight interactions
 show hint for debug log in benchmark
 created minimum pixel count in benchmark
 benchmark debug log text rework (press F3) 
 rework of controller and button help (F1 or "start" on controller)
 sound rework in the main menu
 solved 4k monitor bug - coin history shows first line on startup
 map destruction warnings now bigger and last 60 seconds instead of 30
 improving the red and yellow scanning algorithm to save fps 
 a lot of further minor visual/game-play/calculation improvements and debugging
